title: JTME Server Update — Ynfernal Isle Has Arrived!
summary: The JTME update has arrived! Explore Ynfernal Isle, discover new systems, face new bosses, enjoy PvP improvements, and experience many gameplay adjustments.
text:
Hello everyone!

The JTME update has arrived! Check out everything that has changed:

• Ynfernal Isle — New Region
A volcanic island guarded by lava and fire creatures! Explore level 200+ areas, featuring reports of unexplored caves beyond the known lands. There you will discover a new local trade for ores extracted from lava rocks.

4 New Bosses: Face long dungeons and earn the level 139 weapon fragment. There is also a level 500+ Boss in the center of the volcano that drops the level 169 weapon fragment.

• Vocations and Adjustments
New Attribute: Focus — Each point increases a small percentage of your bonuses: spell damage, critical strike chance, duration of received buffs, and healing power. Check it out in your attributes menu!

Critical Damage System: Your character, pets, and NPCs can now deal critical damage, featuring a new visual effect upon landing a critical hit.

Attack & Defense System Reworked.

• New Raids
Danger no longer runs on a schedule! Raids now happen at completely random times after each server save. Stay alert — the Dragon Salmur, Queen Gorgona, and Abominath can appear at any moment.

• Fair Play Improvements
New Report System accessible directly from the in-game menu.

Profanity filter added against inappropriate language in chat.

Enhanced Anti-Macro System — the use of macros can now result in automatic character jail.

Login bug fixed: The "character is already online" error is gone. You can now log in normally and continue playing.

• Fixes and Adjustments
Arinar Pet Arena adjusted for fairer battles.

PK System fixed: Your skull will now only increase when killing a player within a valid PK level range.

Pet Buff bugs fixed: Your character will no longer mistake their pet for an enemy.

War Island Cage 2 adjusted: High-level monsters now respawn slower.

Initial game tutorial revamped for new players.

New translations added to menus and interfaces.

Internal optimizations implemented for better overall performance.

• New PVP Rank: Hall of Honor
The PVP rank has been reset and adjusted; now, only valid kills are counted.

Each kill grants Honor Points (these are not lost upon death) which can be used to buy buffs, items, and outfits in the store.

Dying to another player resets your kill streak and sends you back to the "Newbie" rank.

Scoring 5 consecutive kills makes you "Hunted" for 30 minutes, leaving you vulnerable to attacks even inside a PZ (Protection Zone).

Enjoy the update and good luck exploring Ynfernal Isle!

JTME Team

text:

title: 💘 Love is in the Air at JTME!
summary: Brazilian Valentine's Day has arrived at JTME! Face themed creatures, earn exclusive rewards, and maybe even pop the big question to your hunt partner. The event starts TODAY after Server Save!
text:
Love is in the air at JTME! 💘

It might not be February 14th, but the romance is in full swing! In Brazil, Valentine's Day is celebrated on June 12th, and we couldn't let this date go unnoticed.

It's time to call that special someone to celebrate by spreading lots of love and arrows across the server! It starts TODAY, right after the Server Save. Gear up, grab your "duo", and come celebrate with us!

• Challenges & Rewards: Get ready to face themed creatures and secure exclusive items and bonuses that we've specially prepared for you.

• The question everyone is waiting for... You know that partner who helps you on hunts and never lets you die to bosses? Maybe it's time to ask the big question: "Will you marry me?"

Don't miss out! Love is beautiful, but the event drops are even better. ❤️

Happy hunting and Happy Valentine's Day!
JTME Team

title: Our Website Has Been Updated!
summary: The site has been completely revamped with a new interface, native translation system, rule adjustments, and a new donation method for Brazil.
text:
Hello everyone! We are constantly working to improve your experience, and today we are excited to announce that our website has undergone a major update. Check out what's new:

• New Interface: The look has been completely revamped! The site is now more modern, intuitive, and faster, making it easier to navigate and access the information you need.

• Native Translation System: We've implemented a translation system directly on the website. Now, you can easily switch between languages, ensuring our entire community stays up to date with news and rules.

• Rule Adjustments: We have reviewed and adjusted some of our system guidelines to ensure a fairer and more organized environment for everyone. We recommend reviewing them in the terms/rules section.

• New Donation System (Brazil Exclusive): We've launched a new contribution method, currently available only for Brazil. This system has been optimized to be faster and more secure for our Brazilian players.

We are very happy with the direction the project is taking and thank you all for your ongoing support!

Visit now and check out the changes: https://otjtme.com/

Best regards, JTME Team
